title: California Department of Education 2027-28 California State Preschool Program
text:
California Department of Education 2027-28 California State Preschool Program
  – Approval of Submission of a Continued Funding Application for Contract
  Renewal; Adopt Resolution
summary: Approves applying to the California Department of Education for continued funding to renew the 2027-28 California State Preschool Program contract, and adopts the accompanying resolution.

details.action: approve funding application for contract renewal; adopt resolution
